assessment_basis: Valid alternative. updateBounds recomputes min/max over all items; not clearing index caches can cause extra recomputation when no finite extreme exists, but cannot retain an incorrect finite bound. The extra post-recomputation add step is idempotent because that item is already included. Full saved class with actual JFreeChart dependencies passed 20,000 insert/overwrite operations including NaN extrema against freshly recomputed bounds. The historical class exposes add, not public remove methods; the earlier concern about remove APIs was misplaced.
